scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:migrate && npm run test:public-api
scripts.test:unit: jest tests/migrate.test.js tests/openapi.test.js tests/adminPostCommand.test.js tests/adminPostLifecycle.test.js tests/outboxProcessor.test.js --runInBand
scripts.test:migrate: docker compose -f docker-compose.migration-test.yml up -d --wait && RUN_MIGRATION_INTEGRATION=1 jest tests/migrations.integration.test.js --runInBand; status=$?; docker compose -f docker-compose.migration-test.yml down -v; exit $status
scripts.test:public-api: docker compose -f docker-compose.migration-test.yml up -d --wait && RUN_PUBLIC_API_INTEGRATION=1 jest tests/publicContent.integration.test.js --runInBand; status=$?; docker compose -f docker-compose.migration-test.yml down -v; exit $status
